newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to sell 49 pct of state cigarette maker.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to sell 49 pct of state cigarette maker.

text.p: Bulgaria plans to offer for sale next year up to 49 percent of cigarette maker Bulgartabac Holding as part of its privatisation programme, Trade Minister Atanas Paparisov said.
"The government today approved privatisation plans for Bulgartabac Holding which envisage that at least 51 percent remains state-owned," Paparizov told reporters after Thursday's cabinet session.
"We expect to attract as potential buyers big foreign, probably European companies. Long-term contracts for distribution offers would be considered an advantage," he said.
Under the scheme, up to 66 percent of the capital in 12 Bulgartabac subsidiaries will also be offered.
Private investors have so far acquired a 10 percent stake in several Bulgartabac companies.
Two subsidiaries - the tobacco factories in Gotse Delchev and Assenovgrad -- are expected to be privatised through an offer of new shares, a cabinet statement said.
